items.title: Profile your Amazon CloudWatch Logs estate with an AWS DevOps Agent skill in sandbox, no infrastructure to deploy
items.summary: A zero-infrastructure  AWS DevOps Agent skill profiles your Amazon CloudWatch Logs estate and gives you one view of it. CloudWatch Logs already captures the signals you need to operate it well, including how each log group is classed, how long it is kept, who reads it, where its data flows, and how fast it grows. […]
items.creator: Rohan Vashi
